title: Contrastive Mask Fidelity: Reference-Free Auditing of Ground-Truth Masks in Remote Sensing Semantic Segmentation
mechanism: Reference-free score of how well each ground-truth mask agrees with its image, to flag coarse, incomplete or misaligned masks.
adaptation: Score all 582 + 106 crack and inactive masks; publish fidelity with the benchmark and report test scores with low-fidelity cells flagged (CSIR_00070 should rank bottom). Training: drop or down-weight the worst decile, an automatic B1 audit (24 of 239 flagged, never fixed).
min_experiment: Arm: house trained without the lowest-fidelity 10% crack masks; baseline: house. Metric crack IoU, relF1@2. Kill if n.d. Audit itself is a benchmark deliverable.
evidence: R: remote-sensing segmentation datasets (abstract); numbers not read.
prior_overlap: partial: B1 manual-flag audit done, nothing fixed or removed.

alt_notes.adaptation: EL-aware judge: image-level crack classifier (train + ELPV labels); inpaint the masked crack line and measure drop in p(crack); choose per segment between human and model line; mainly to audit test labels.
alt_notes.min_experiment: Arm: judge on 100 train cells with synthetic 1-2 px shifts. Baseline: ridge-darkness heuristic. Metric: fraction choosing the darkest-ridge line. Kill: < 70%.
